events.name: Movement onset
events.baseline: body_weight_N from the accepted quiet-standing window
events.persistence: ceil(sample_rate_hz * 0.020) consecutive samples meeting the threshold
events.search_interval: first sample after the accepted quiet-standing window through the last sample before the takeoff search result
events.sample_index_convention: event index is the first sample of the persistent run; no sample is backdated or averaged
events.time_convention: event time is the input timestamp at event index
events.return_to_baseline_behavior: Not required; later return through baseline does not change the first onset event.
events.limitation: Force-time onset is a defined operational boundary, not a claim that it equals the first joint-flexion instant.

events.name: Takeoff
events.baseline: absolute force threshold; body-weight baseline is not substituted
events.persistence: ceil(sample_rate_hz * 0.020) consecutive samples meeting the threshold
events.dual_plate_behavior: Apply the threshold to the formed total F_vertical_N; do not apply independent thresholds to left and right channels.
events.search_interval: first sample after movement onset through the last sample before landing search
events.sample_index_convention: event index is the first sample of the persistent run
events.time_convention: event time is the input timestamp at event index
events.limitation: The fixed 20 N operational threshold is scoped to v1 and is not a universal force-platform takeoff standard.

events.name: Landing
events.baseline: absolute force threshold; body-weight baseline is not substituted
events.direction: upward from near-zero force to contact force
events.persistence: ceil(sample_rate_hz * 0.020) consecutive samples meeting the threshold
events.dual_plate_behavior: Apply the threshold to the formed total F_vertical_N; preserve the two source channels without diagnosing asymmetry.
events.search_interval: first sample after takeoff_index through the last sample of the acquisition
events.sample_index_convention: event index is the first sample of the persistent run
events.time_convention: event time is the input timestamp at event index
events.limitation: A force threshold detects return to measurable plate load; it does not identify the first anatomical contact instant.
